capabilities: Chat with local Ollama models using streaming Markdown responses
Search, read, create, and edit notes through built-in agent tools
Find related notes by meaning with a local semantic index
Store long-term memories and reusable Markdown skills
Render Mermaid diagrams in the chat
extras: Vault-changing actions prompt for approval unless YOLO mode is enabled; the semantic index is stored in the browser's IndexedDB, and note content is sent to whatever Ollama host is configured, including a remote one. The bundled diagrammer skill is off by default and enabled under Experimental settings.
motivation: The author wanted minimalistic, lightweight tools where AI helps when needed and stays out of the way when not.
problem: Chatting with your notes and letting a model act on the vault requires a local model plus tools wired into Obsidian, which the app does not provide on its own.

relations.evidence: Porygon requires Ollama to be installed and running locally.

summary: Local-first AI chat assistant that runs Ollama models inside Obsidian and uses agent tools to search, read, and edit vault notes.
